世界有很多问题，: The world is full of questions.
让知识动起来。换一种条件，看看会发生什么；: Bring science to life. Change a condition and see what happens;

从一个演示开始，逐步探索更多。: Start with one demo, then explore a little further.
从恒星的旅程开始，观察引力怎样改变运动。: Follow a star's journey and see how gravity changes its motion.
山川、海洋、天气，以及我们生活的这颗星球。: Mountains, oceans, weather, and the planet we call home.
从一片叶子到我们的身体，认识生命怎样运转。: From a leaf to our own bodies, discover how living things work.
光、声音、力与变化，藏在日常生活里的问题。: Light, sound, forces and change in everyday questions.
观察工具、机器和结构，理解它们怎样工作。: Explore tools, machines and structures to see how they work.
恒星路过黑洞: A star passes a black hole
恒星会被吞掉吗？换一条路线，观察引力、瓦解与气体的不同去向。: Will the star be swallowed? Change its route and compare gravity, disruption and the paths of the gas.
太阳系八大行星运转与大小比较: The solar system: orbits and sizes
观察八大行星的公转快慢，再让太阳与行星按同一个直径尺度排队，比较它们的大小。: Compare the orbital speeds of eight planets, then line up the Sun and planets at one diameter scale.
为什么会有白天黑夜与四季更迭: Why do we have day, night and seasons?
真实三维地球呈现：地球为什么一边是白昼一边是黑夜？又是什么带来了春夏秋冬？直观理: Explore a 3D Earth: why is one side in daylight and the other in darkness? See how rotation and a 23.44° axial tilt shape the seasons.
从牛顿三棱镜色散到单个雨滴折射内反射，揭开 42° 笛卡尔光线、霓虹双彩虹、亚历: From Newton's prism dispersion to raindrop internal reflection, discover the science behind Descartes rays at 42°, double rainbows, Alexander's dark band, and full-circle rainbows.
把阳光拆开，跟着光线穿过一滴雨。动手探索色散、双彩虹，以及太阳高度如何改变天空中: Split sunlight and follow a ray through a raindrop. Explore dispersion, double rainbows, and how the height of the Sun changes the bow.
黑洞身边的星系: A galaxy around a black hole
从恒星的轨道，到发光的吸积盘，再退后看一整个星系。黑洞身边，究竟谁在绕行，谁在落: Explore stellar orbits, a glowing accretion disk, and a whole galaxy. What keeps circling, and what falls inward?
行星遇到黑洞: A planet meets a black hole
如果路过黑洞的不是太阳，而是一颗蓝色岩石行星，或一颗条纹气态巨行星，会发生什么？: What if the visitor is a blue rocky planet or a striped gas giant, instead of a star?
黑洞与伴星: A black hole and its companion
恒星没有一下子消失，却有气体不断流向身边的黑洞。跟着一小团气体，看懂双星中的持续: The star remains, while gas keeps flowing toward its black hole companion. Follow a parcel to explore accretion in a binary system.
从一片叶子放大到细胞和叶绿体，看看绿色从哪里来，秋天的黄色和红色又藏在哪里。: Zoom from a leaf into its cells and chloroplasts to discover its green color and the yellows and reds of autumn.
月亮为什么有圆有缺？绕着地球走一圈，同时看太空中的月球和地面上看到的月相。: Why does the Moon change shape? Follow its orbit and compare the view from space with the phase seen from Earth.
土星的身边不只有光环。认识七颗代表卫星，比较绕行快慢、真实大小和不同的冰雪世界。: Saturn has more than rings. Meet seven representative moons and compare their orbital speeds, true sizes and icy worlds.
一块太空岩石撞上月球后会怎样？改变大小和速度，看岩石飞散、地面凹陷，留下一个撞击: What happens when a space rock hits the Moon? Change its size and speed, then watch excavation, ejecta and the crater left behind.
打开火山的剖面，看岩浆怎样向上走。试试一个喷口和多个喷口，再比较熔岩流与火山灰喷: Open a volcano in cross section. Follow rising magma, try one or several vents, and compare flowing lava with ash-rich eruptions.
火山喷发之后，为什么可能留下一座湖？比较火山口和破火山口，试着让雨水积起来，或从: Why can a lake form after volcanism? Compare a crater and a caldera, then let water accumulate or drain through the ground.
暖海水怎样帮助风暴成长？改变海温、风切变和半球，看雷雨能否组织成带有螺旋云带的热: How does warm ocean water help a storm grow? Change sea temperature, wind shear and hemisphere to explore tropical cyclone organization.
从不同高度的风开始，观察雷暴中的旋转怎样发展。漏斗云和触地的旋转气流，是不是同一: Start with winds at different heights and explore rotation in a thunderstorm. Is a visible funnel cloud the same as a ground-reaching vortex?
比较六颗行星的岩石、海水和云层，看看我们说的表面究竟在哪里。: Compare rock, seawater and clouds on six planets. Where exactly is a planet’s surface?
含羞草为什么会合拢？: Why does mimosa fold its leaves?
触碰之后，跟着信号走进含羞草的叶枕，观察离子、水分和膨压怎样让小叶合拢。: Follow a touch signal into the pulvinus and explore how ions, water and turgor fold a mimosa leaflet.
绣球花为什么有不同颜色？: Why do hydrangeas have different colors?
从土壤到萼片细胞，观察酸度、铝和品种如何共同影响绣球花的蓝、紫、粉与白。: From soil to sepal cells, explore how acidity, aluminum and cultivar shape blue, purple, pink and white hydrangea blooms.
云里的小水滴，怎样变成落到地面的雨？走进云中，比较暖云、冰晶和干燥空气带来的不同: How do tiny cloud droplets become rain at the ground? Look inside a cloud and compare warm droplets, ice growth and evaporation in dry air.
云里怎样积累电荷？闪电为什么会分叉，为什么总是先看见闪电再听见雷声？把一次放电放: How does a cloud separate charge? Why does lightning branch, and why does thunder arrive later? Slow down one discharge and follow the journeys of light and sound.
水为什么能托住小船？: Why can water hold up a boat?
从一块木头、一团橡皮泥开始，亲眼看看水向上托的力。: Start with wood and clay. See the upward push of water.
影子为什么变长变短？: Why do shadows grow and shrink?
移动小灯，看看小木偶的影子躲到了哪一边。: Move the lamp and watch which way the wooden puppet’s shadow points.
慢慢玩 · 约 5—8 分钟: Explore at your pace · About 5–8 minutes
冰变成水，水又去哪儿了？: Ice melts. Where does the water go?
给同一杯水换个环境，观察结冰、融化、蒸发和凝结。: Change the surroundings of one cup of water and explore freezing, melting, evaporation and condensation.
先挑一个物品，再让磁铁靠近。换成另一块磁铁，还能试试“推开”。: Choose an object and move the magnet closer. Try a second magnet to discover a push as well as a pull.
拨一下橡皮筋，看它来回振动。把它绷紧一点，再听听声音。: Pluck a rubber band and watch it vibrate. Tighten it and listen again.
滑出去的玩具为什么会停？: Why does a sliding toy stop?
三块一样的木头，从一样快的速度出发。看看哪条路让它滑得更远。: Three identical wooden toys start at the same speed. Which surface lets one slide farther?
毛毛虫怎样变成蝴蝶？: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?
从卵到成虫，看见毛毛虫的成长和蛹里面的变化。: Follow a butterfly from egg to adult and explore the changes inside a chrysalis.
蝌蚪怎样变成青蛙？: How does a tadpole become a frog?
推着时间向前，看腿长出来、尾巴逐渐被身体吸收。: Move through growth to see legs appear and the tail gradually be absorbed.
蚂蚁为什么排着队走？: Why do ants walk in a line?
显示看不见的气味路线，观察断点和新路线怎样影响蚂蚁。: Make a scent trail visible and explore a gap and a newly discovered route.
跟随水流经过鱼鳃，看溶在水里的氧气进入血液。: Follow water across the gills and see dissolved oxygen enter the blood.
鸭子的脚为什么像船桨？: Why are duck feet like paddles?
放大鸭子的蹼足，观察向后推水和收脚回程的不同形状。: Enlarge a duck foot to compare the push and return phases of paddling.
谁藏在树叶和树枝里？: Who is hiding among the leaves?
在树林里寻找三只动物，换背景比较保护色和拟态。: Find three animals and change their background to explore camouflage and resemblance.
给豆子一点水、一点空气和合适的温度，再翻开成长相册。: Give a bean water, air and a suitable temperature, then turn through its growth album.
轻轻的绒毛、小小的钩子，都能帮种子离开妈妈身边。选一种，再送它一程。: Fluffy hairs and tiny hooks can help seeds leave their parent plant. Pick one and send it on its way.
根喝到的水怎样到叶子里？: How does water reach the leaves?
一起跟着蓝色水滴，从土里出发，走过根和茎，最后来到叶子。: Follow the blue water markers from soil through roots and stem, all the way to a leaf.
花为什么会变成果实？: How does a flower become fruit?
让蜜蜂把合适的花粉带到樱桃花上，再看花里面慢慢发生什么。: Help a bee bring compatible pollen to a cherry flower, then see what happens inside.
仙人掌怎样留住水？: How does a cactus save water?
给沙漠下一场雨，看看胖胖的茎怎样储水，再打开白天和夜晚的窗口。: Bring rain to the desert, watch the thick stem store water, and switch between day and night.
从地面的水，到云里的小水滴，再回到河流和大海。: From surface water to tiny cloud droplets, then back to rivers and the sea.
让水从山坡流下来，看看它怎样绕开石头，又怎样改变河岸。: Send water downhill. Watch it pass rocks and reshape the banks.
沙滩上的沙子从哪里来？: Where does beach sand come from?
跟着一粒小沙子，看岩石和贝壳怎样留下海边的颗粒。: Follow a grain and discover how rocks and shells supply beach sediment.
雨水落到地上以后呢？: What happens to rain on the ground?
给不同的地面下一场雨，看看水流走了、渗下去了，还是留下来了。: Rain on different surfaces. Does the water run off, soak in, or stay?
太阳也是一颗星星吗？: Is the Sun a star too?
把观察者带远一些：太阳看起来变小了，它本身有变小吗？: Move the observer farther away: the Sun looks smaller, but has the Sun itself shrunk?
流星是星星掉下来了吗？: Is a meteor a falling star?
跟着一小块太空碎片，看看它进入大气时发生什么。: Follow a small piece of space debris and see what happens when it enters the atmosphere.
切换动物、叶肉植物和细菌细胞，找一找膜、DNA 与细胞核。: Compare animal, leaf mesophyll and bacterial cells. Find their membranes, DNA and nuclei.
细菌是什么？都会让人生病吗？: What are bacteria? Do they all make us sick?
放大一颗细菌，看看身体结构，再去酸奶、土壤和肠道里找它们的不同角色。: Look inside a bacterium, then explore the different roles of bacteria in yogurt, soil, and the gut.
病毒是什么？为什么需要细胞？: What are viruses, and why do they need cells?
换一个宿主，逐步看噬菌体如何借助细菌制造新的病毒。: Change the host and see, step by step, how a phage uses a bacterial cell to make new viruses.
换着看土壤、池水、皮肤和空气，分清被带到、活下来与长出更多。: Explore soil, pond water, skin and air, and distinguish arrival, survival and reproduction.
放大一杯水，比较煮沸前后：病原体、矿物质和化学污染，并不会发生同样的变化。: Look inside a glass of water and compare before and after boiling: pathogens, minerals and chemical contamination do not all change in the same way.
肥皂为什么能帮忙洗手？: How does soap help wash our hands?
沿着掌心、手背和指尖找一找：肥皂、搓洗与流动清水怎样合作，把污物带走？: Explore palms, backs and fingertips: how do soap, rubbing and running water work together to carry dirt away?
刹车了，为什么还要系安全带？: If the car brakes, why wear a seat belt?
汽车停下需要一段路，身体也需要一起慢下来。看看轮胎、刹车和儿童座椅怎样接力保护我: A car needs distance to stop, and our bodies need to slow down too. Explore how tires, brakes and child seats work together.
慢慢玩 · 约 6—9 分钟: Explore at your pace · About 6–9 minutes
先动手观察，再说说你发现了什么。: Try the experiment, then describe what you notice.
深入说明已展开：继续往下看原理、模型边界与来源。: Deeper notes are open below: explore the explanation, model limits and sources.
一段可以慢慢讲的解说: A story to tell at your own pace
跟随皮肤到脊髓的信号，比较缩回反射与向脑传递的两条路径。: Follow a signal from skin to spinal cord and compare withdrawal and ascending routes.
放大舌乳头与味蕾，比较味觉和后鼻嗅觉怎样共同参与风味。: Enlarge a papilla and taste bud, and compare taste with retronasal smell in flavor.
红细胞和白细胞在做什么？: What do red and white blood cells do?
放大看血液中的分工：运氧气、参与防御，以及一起帮助止血。: Explore jobs in blood: carrying oxygen, immune defence and working together to stop bleeding.
身体里的细胞为什么长得不一样？: Why do body cells have different shapes?
比较皮肤、肌肉与神经元，观察形状怎样帮助它们保护、运动和传递信息。: Compare skin, muscle and neurons. See how structure supports protection, movement and communication.
放大耳朵、耳蜗和感觉细胞，追踪振动怎样变成传向脑的消息。: Explore the ear, cochlea and sensory cells as vibration becomes a message to the brain.
拉长再松开泡泡，放大薄膜，观察表面张力、液体排流和干涉色。: Stretch and release a bubble, then enlarge its film to explore surface tension, drainage and interference colors.
食物吃下去以后去哪儿？: Where does food go after we eat?
跟随食物走过消化管，放大小肠绒毛，比较营养进入血液与淋巴的路线。: Follow food through the digestive tract, enlarge a villus, and compare nutrient routes into blood and lymph.
